items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: Paul sent for Georgie Brunus which he came to my father and my father gave Georgie the train fare to get up there

ctx.x: That's where he's playing. We could almost count the keys on the clarinet there.

That's right. And that's Jack Pettis in the background there. That's the original first band put together. When Alma Schober was on piano and Jack Pettis on sax and rapping, Paul and Georgie and Mel Stetzel also played a little with the band.
Well, that covers quite a few. I was going to ask, too. At home, you say you have a big collection, too, I imagine. Bill, I have a marvelous collection. I have thousands of them.
